This '''national electoral calendar for 2015''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2015 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*4 January: [[Elections in Uzbekistan|Uzbekistan]], [[Uzbekistani parliamentary election, 2014–2015|Legislative Chamber (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.osce.org/odihr/elections/105439 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140408133912/http://www.osce.org/odihr/elections/105439 | archive-date=8 April 2014 | title=Elections in the OSCE Area in 2014 | publisher=[[Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe|OCSE]] | access-date=16 January 2016 }}</ref>
*8 January: [[Elections in Sri Lanka|Sri Lanka]], [[2015 Sri Lankan presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Presidential poll Jan. 8; Nominations on Dec. 8 |url=http://www.dailymirror.lk/57111/presidential-polls-jan-8-nominations-on-dec-8 |newspaper=[[The Daily Mirror (Sri Lanka)|Daily Mirror]] |location=Colombo |date=21 November 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Sri Lanka's Rajapaksa facing electoral rebellion |url=http://www.dw.de/sri-lankas-rajapaksa-facing-electoral-rebellion/a-18078912 |publisher=[[Deutsche Welle]] |date=21 November 2014}}</ref>
*11 January: [[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2014–15 Croatian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Croatia presidency vote goes to runoff after tight contest |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-30614291 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=28 December 2014 |access-date=13 March 2015}}</ref>
*20 January: [[Elections in Zambia|Zambia]], [[2015 Zambian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web |author=Peter Adamu |title=Guy Scott Sets Jan. 20 for Presidential By Election |url=http://zambiareports.com/2014/11/18/guy-scott-sets-jan-20-presidential-election/ |work=Zambia Reports |location=Lusaka |date=18 November 2014 |access-date=13 March 2015}}</ref>
*25 January: 
**[[Elections in Comoros|Comoros]], [[2015 Comorian legislative election|Parliament (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Greece|Greece]], [[January 2015 Greek legislative election|Parliament]]

==February==
*7 February: [[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2015 Slovak same-sex marriage referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web |author=Roman Cuprik |title=President sets date for 'family' referendum |url=http://spectator.sme.sk/articles/view/56161/2/president_sets_date_for_family_referendum.html |newspaper=[[The Slovak Spectator]] |location=Bratislava |date=8 December 2014 |access-date=13 March 2015}}</ref>
*16 February: [[Elections in Saint Kitts and Nevis|Saint Kitts and Nevis]], [[2015 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web |author=LK Hewlett |title=It's Election Day in St. Kitts And Nevis |url=http://www.thestkittsnevisobserver.com/2015/02/13/election-day.html |newspaper=[[The St. Kitts-Nevis Observer]] |location=Basseterre |date=16 February 2015 |access-date=13 March 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://archive.today/20150217110449/http://www.thestkittsnevisobserver.com/2015/02/13/election-day.html |archive-date=17 February 2015 }}</ref>
*22 February: [[Elections in Comoros|Comoros]], [[2015 Comorian legislative election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
*28 February: [[Elections in Lesotho|Lesotho]], [[2015 Lesotho general election|National Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Lesotho: Former President of Botswana to Lead Commonwealth Observers for Lesotho Elections |url=http://allafrica.com/stories/201502191612.html |website=[[AllAfrica.com]] |agency=[[Commonwealth of Nations|Commonwealth News and Information Service (London)]] |date=18 February 2015 |access-date=13 March 2015}}</ref>

**[[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2015 Salvadoran legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Final election results in El Salvador give ARENA majority in congress |url=http://www.ticotimes.net/2015/03/29/final-election-results-in-el-salvador-give-arena-majority-in-congress |work=[[The Tico Times]] |agency=[[Agence France-Presse]] |location=[[San José, Costa Rica]] |date=29 March 2015 |access-date=8 June 2015}}</ref>

März 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150623235539/http://www.bk.admin.ch/themen/pore/va/20150308/index.html|archive-date=23 June 2015|url-status=dead|publisher=Swiss Federal Chancellery}}</ref>

*28–29 March: [[Elections in Nigeria|Nigeria]], [[2015 Nigerian general election|President, House of Representatives and Senate]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Nigeria election: Partial extension of voting to Sunday |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-32095283 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=28 March 2015 |access-date=28 March 2015}}</ref>
*29 March: [[Elections in Uzbekistan|Uzbekistan]], [[2015 Uzbekistani presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Uzbeks Vote in Heavily Criticized Presidential Election |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/uzbekistan-karimov-presidential-election/26926111.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=29 March 2015 |access-date=29 March 2015}}</ref>
*31 March: [[Elections in Tuvalu|Tuvalu]], [[2015 Tuvaluan general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Tuvalu elections being held today |url=http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/270047/tuvalu-elections-being-held-today |work=[[Radio New Zealand International]] |date=31 March 2015 |access-date=2 April 2015}}</ref>

**''[[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2015 Northern Cyprus presidential election|President (1st round)]]''<ref name="NC">{{cite news |author=Simon Bahceli |title=Turkish Cypriot leadership vote goes to runoff |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyprus-turkish-election-idUSKBN0NA00X20150419 |date=19 April 2015 |work=[[Reuters]] |location=Nicosia |access-date=20 April 2015}}</ref>

**[[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2015 Beninese parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref name="eisa">{{cite web |year=2015 |title=African election calendar 2015 |url=http://www.content.eisa.org.za/old-page/african-election-calendar-2015 |publisher=[[Electoral Institute for Sustainable Democracy in Africa]] |location=South Africa |access-date=4 April 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150227192613/http://www.content.eisa.org.za/old-page/african-election-calendar-2015 |archive-date=27 February 2015 }}</ref>
**[[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2015 Kazakhstani presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Kazakh President Sets Date For Early Presidential Election |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/nazarbaev-sets-date-for-presidnetial-election/26869148.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=25 February 2015 |access-date=13 March 2015}}</ref>
**''[[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2015 Northern Cyprus presidential election|President (2nd round)]]''<ref name="NC" />

**[[Elections in Guyana|Guyana]], [[2015 Guyanese general election|President and Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Guyana votes in general election |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-32688776 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=11 May 2015 |access-date=20 May 2015}}</ref>

**[[Elections in Ethiopia|Ethiopia]], [[2015 Ethiopian general election|House of Peoples' Representatives]]<ref name="eisa"/>

**[[Elections in Luxembourg|Luxembourg]], [[2015 Luxembourg constitutional referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Four questions for Luxembourg referendum |url=http://www.wort.lu/en/politics/foreigner-voting-rights-four-questions-for-luxembourg-referendum-542046a5b9b398870806970e |newspaper=[[Luxemburger Wort]] |date=22 September 2014 |access-date=13 March 2015 |archive-date=17 May 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150517055049/http://www.wort.lu/en/politics/foreigner-voting-rights-four-questions-for-luxembourg-referendum-542046a5b9b398870806970e |url-status=dead }}</ref>
**[[Elections in Mexico|Mexico]], [[2015 Mexican legislative election|Chamber of Deputies]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Mexico elections: President's party set to retain power |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-33041353 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=8 June 2015 |access-date=8 June 2015}}</ref>

März 2015 |url=http://www.bk.admin.ch/themen/pore/va/20150614/index.html |access-date=5 July 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704013155/http://www.bk.admin.ch/themen/pore/va/20150614/index.html |archive-date=4 July 2015 |url-status=dead |publisher=Swiss Federal Chancellery}}</ref>

*5 July: [[Elections in Greece|Greece]], [[2015 Greek bailout referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Greece debt crisis: Tsipras announces bailout referendum |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-33296839 |work=[[BBC News]] |date=27 June 2015 |access-date=27 June 2015}}</ref>
